messages:
Nora (People Ops): Hey all 1 1 1 sharing a tiny OKR + feedback starter pack tailored for fast cycles. Copy/paste friendly.

Diego (Product Eng Manager): love short packs. can we have an example OKR + one-liner acceptance criteria?

Nora (People Ops): Yes — included below. also a 3-question peer feedback micro-form and a manager coaching script (3 bullets).

perf-bot: Reminder: Q2 OKR alignment session in 3 days. Agenda posted at /okrs.

Nora (People Ops): [STARTER PACK]
1) Example OKR (copyable)
- Objective: Make embeddings 2x cheaper at 99% of query traffic.
- Key Results:
  * KR1: Reduce average embedding cost per query by 50%.
  * KR2: Maintain retrieval latency p95 < 120ms for 99% of queries.
  * KR3: Ship caching + mem-opt pattern with rollout to 3 services.
- Acceptance (one-liner): "KR met when cost/latency targets verified in prod for 30 days."

2) Self-review goal reflection prompt (send to ICs)
- Paste 2 bullets: 1) what I owned (outcome + metric), 2) one blocker and how manager can help. <=180 chars each.

3) Micro peer-feedback (3 quick Qs)
- Q1: One concrete strength? (30-60 chars)
- Q2: One area to improve? (30-60 chars)
- Q3: Quick suggestion to help next quarter? (<=100 chars)

4) Manager coaching script (30-60s lines)
- Acknowledge the win + tie to objective.
- Ask: "What helped you deliver this?" then ask for a learning.
- Agree one measurable next-step and owner.

Diego (Product Eng Manager): This is perfect. can we add a line that managers should attach a link to 1 artifact (PR/metric/dashboard)?

Nora (People Ops): Good call 1 added to the self-review and pre-read checklist.

Mei (SWE): tiny nit: can the peer form be anonymous? people will give briefer feedback otherwise.

Arun (People Ops Lead): We'll make peer feedback anonymous by default. thanks Nora, will add to the OKR playbook and ping teams.

Nora (People Ops): Great 1 will update the OKR template and drop the starter pack into /okrs and the manager playbook. DM me for tweaks. :rocket:
